notes.title: Core Mechanics Refactor 01
notes.notes:
We completed a large Core Mechanics Refactor to clean up data management to work better with a Multiplayer design. 

Newly updated features include the Inventory System, Merchant Interaction, Chest Interaction, Procedural Plant Growth, Item Drops, User Interface, Plant Harvesting, Tree Chopping, Mining, and NPC Interaction.

We have also added several new Clothing Sets and many new game items.

notes.title: Newly Added Mechanics
notes.notes: We've begun adding the planned combat system, and limited multiplayer functions for testing purposes. These will be focused on heavily before proceeding to the next planned mechanics to ensure solid core mechanics upon which to build more gameplay. There are a lot of exciting things in the works!
